name: Mikaela
source:
Mikaela is the beautiful guardian angel of Earth. She is very noble and has high integrity. Because of her great power, she has gained the highest class in Heaven. Although she is filled with compassion, she punishes evil very thoroughly. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=756865]Getchu[/url]]
